home.noTeams: No teams yet. Create one and the leader and members will collaborate here.
home.emptyTitle: Hand one job to a whole team
home.emptyBody: Pick a working folder and CoBot sets up a leader and members for it. Tell the leader your goal; it splits the work into tasks for the members, and asks you before anyone runs a command or edits a file.
home.pickTitle: Who do you want to talk to?
home.selectBot: Pick a member on the left, or go straight to a leader.

archived.restored: “{{name}}” is restored and back in the team list
archived.deleteBody: Their members, conversations, tasks, memories, Codex sessions and the .cobot folder in the project are permanently removed. This cannot be undone. Other project files are not touched.

team.directoryNested: Nested with the directory of team {{teamName}}
team.archiveConfirmBody: The team moves from the team list to Settings › Archived teams, its Codex process stops, and it keeps its folder. Conversations and data stay; you can restore it at any time.
team.deleteMissingConfirmBody: The team's project folder is no longer where it was. Deleting permanently removes its members, conversations, tasks, memories and Codex sessions, including any unfinished work. This cannot be undone.
team.deleteMemberConfirmBody: Its conversation, memories, runs, the finished tasks it owned and its Codex session in this team are permanently removed. This cannot be undone. Messages it sent to other members stay. The role itself is not affected and stays available to other teams.
team.directoryFixed: A team's folder cannot change after creation.
team.membersLocked: Existing members cannot be changed here; tick new roles to add them.
team.directoryArchived: This folder belongs to the archived team “{{teamName}}”. Restore that team to keep using it.
team.directoryClaimed: This folder is already used by team “{{teamName}}”; a new team cannot be created here
team.directoryClaimedUnknown: This folder is already used by a team in another CoBot environment; a new team cannot be created here
team.directoryPlaceholder: or paste the folder's full path

stats.estimateNote: First token is estimated from each turn's start to its first step; speed is output tokens over model time.
stats.contextNote: From the tokens of the last model call; Codex does not break it down into system prompt, tools and conversation.

effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.note: Applies from each member's next turn. Higher effort thinks more, takes longer and uses more.

hint.read_only: Can look and analyse; asks before changing anything
hint.default: Free to read, write and run inside the team folder; asks beyond it
hint.full: Never asks; not limited to the team folder

confirmFull.title: Switch to full access?
confirmFull.body: Members will run any command and change any file without asking, beyond the team folder and network limits. Applies from each member's next turn.

conversation.emptyLeader: Tell the leader what you want done. It agrees a plan with you first and assigns members once you confirm.
conversation.emptyMember: Members usually get work from the leader. You can also ask this member a question or add details here.
